purpose: Implement and test posterior-threshold squared-residual planning, explicitly separating expected evidence from event probability.
scope: Existing paper15 historical frozen pair and the same already-seen day. No topology refitting, new network, or selection of test truth for planning.

likelihood.type: two frozen linear Gaussian candidates with a common fixed diagonal voltage covariance
likelihood.history: Use all existing historical validation observations once; recompute squared Gaussian likelihood, never exponentiate stored MAE.
likelihood.noise_source: Explicit existing 96-slot sigma profile; repeat for the three historical validation days. Synthetic working-likelihood assumption, not empirical posterior calibration.
likelihood.candidate_coverage: Only this fitted pair; no integration over impedance uncertainty or omitted trees.

modes.expected_either: Minimize original prepaid cost subject to the absolute expected log posterior odds reaching logit(0.9); evaluate both directions without test truth.
modes.pair_event_nominal: Optional exact closed-pair benchmark: nominal deterministic power, correct candidate posterior >=0.9 with conditional probability >=0.9 under either of the two working models. Includes history odds; not a guarantee under random delivery or AC.

planning_response.expected_mode: Original independent per-resource multiplicative Gaussian response deviations. Shared deviations in both candidate residuals; evaluate their exact second-moment contribution.
planning_response.nominal_mode: Mean delivery only. Random response is evaluated externally, not silently included in its exact event claim.
planning_response.background_power_uncertainty: No extra background covariance added in the first paper15 run; do not double count existing residual sigma. Core accepts explicit additional residual variance inputs.

resource_domain.resources: Original 20 retained resources, other 40 contracts zero. No capacity redistribution.
resource_domain.policy: Original hourly normalized request and exact causal power/energy/deadline map, not free 15-minute scheduling.
resource_domain.cost: Original quadratic prepaid synthetic contract units; no budget increase or new cost cap.

solver.name: Gurobi global nonconvex QCQP/MIQCP
solver.zero_shortcut: If a physical zero contract meets the new constraint, nonnegative cost proves global cost zero. Retain this outcome; do not alter priors or thresholds to create DR need.

analytic: expected quadratic identity including multiplicative response variance
verification.actual: Freeze quotes, then reuse existing identical observations or run only genuinely new contracts on the original 32 paired execution and metering paths. Compute Bayesian predictions before truth evaluation.
metrics: actual log odds and finite-pool posterior

do_not_claim: expectation constraint equals a chance constraint
posterior is calibrated probability of the true full topology
pair-model guarantee covers all unknown trees
Bayesian selector improvement is DR improvement
